gqlgw

SDL-first GraphQL gateway
running in nginx / OpenResty

@fetch REST calls declared in the schema
No N+1: rounds, deduplication, @batch
C99 core via LuaJIT FFI · 3-level cache
type Post {
  title: String!
  author: User
    @fetch(source: "users",
           path: "/users/{parent.authorId}")
    @batch(path: "/users?ids={keys}",
           match: "id")
}
client
nginx + gqlgw
REST
100 posts + authors: 101 calls → 2 batched → 1 cached
